input.prompt: Quarterly business review for a SaaS company in EMEA

sections.title: Executive summary
sections.content:
- EMEA closed Q3 at EUR 48.6m ARR, up 8.7% quarter on quarter (illustrative figures)
- Net new ARR of EUR 3.9m against a EUR 3.6m target (108%)
- Net revenue retention rose to 113%; gross retention held at 94%
- Focus for Q4: mid-market expansion in DACH and faster onboarding in the Middle East

sections.title: Revenue performance
sections.content:
Net new ARR by month, EUR m (illustrative):

| Month | Target | Actual |
| --- | --- | --- |
| July | 1.1 | 1.1 |
| August | 1.1 | 1.0 |
| September | 1.4 | 1.8 |

September over-delivered on three enterprise renewals with seat expansion; August softness came from summer slippage in Southern Europe.

sections.title: Regional breakdown
sections.content:
| Region | ARR (EUR m) | QoQ growth | NRR |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| UK and Ireland | 14.2 | 7.6% | 112% |
| DACH | 12.8 | 9.4% | 118% |
| France and Benelux | 8.9 | 8.5% | 109% |
| Nordics | 5.6 | 6.1% | 115% |
| Southern Europe | 4.3 | 10.3% | 104% |
| Middle East and Africa | 2.8 | 14.8% | 121% |

DACH and Middle East and Africa lead on expansion; Southern Europe trails on retention.

sections.title: Customer health and retention
sections.content:
Net revenue retention by quarter (illustrative): Q3 2025 108%, Q4 2025 109%, Q1 2026 111%, Q2 2026 112%, Q3 2026 113%.
- Gross retention up from 92% to 94% over the year
- Churn concentrated in accounts under 50 seats
- Onboarding time down from 41 to 29 days

sections.title: Pipeline and Q4 outlook
sections.content:
- Weighted Q4 pipeline of EUR 5.2m against a EUR 4.1m net new ARR target
- 3.1x unweighted coverage
- Risks: two DACH enterprise deals depend on data-residency sign-off; currency headwind on GBP contracts; partner-sourced pipeline still thin in France

sections.title: Priorities for Q4
sections.content:
1. Close the two data-residency deals in DACH with the EU-hosted tier
2. Launch the mid-market package in Benelux and the Nordics
3. Cut onboarding below 21 days with guided setup
4. Double partner-sourced pipeline in France
Owner for each priority reports progress at the monthly EMEA forecast call.
